display.purpose: Page and card headings at 24px, semibold, balanced.

body.purpose: Controls and table text at 14px; dense text at 12px.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Focused modal panel above the overlay.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committed action in a context; inverts between themes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#130b00; color:#f4f4f5; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:8px; font:600 14px 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; border:0; transition:background 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:rgba(0,0,0,.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(82,82,91,.5); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ .ds-btn-primary{ background:#f4f4f5; color:#18181b; } .ds-btn-primary:hover{ background:rgba(244,244,245,.7); } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action; bordered white, flat in dark mode.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#fff; color:#18181b; border:1px solid #e4e4e7; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:8px; font:600 14px 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 300ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:rgba(228,228,231,.5); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(82,82,91,.5); outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ .ds-btn-secondary{ background:#fff; color:#18181b; border-color:transparent; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover{ background:#e4e4e7; } }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; tinted red with a hairline red border.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background:rgba(239,68,68,.10); color:#dc2626; border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.3); padding:8px 16px; border-radius:8px; font:600 14px 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 300ms; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:rgba(239,68,68,.20); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(239,68,68,.4); outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ .ds-btn-danger{ color:#f87171; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line field with label above and a border-shift focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-name">Name</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-name" placeholder="Form title">
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; font:600 12px 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; text-transform:capitalize; color:#18181b; margin-bottom:4px; } .ds-input { width:100%; background:#f4f4f5; color:#18181b; border:1px solid #e4e4e7; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:8px; font:400 14px 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; outline:none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#18181b; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(82,82,91,.5); } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ .ds-label{ color:#f4f4f5; } .ds-input{ background:rgba(24,24,27,.5); color:#f4f4f5; border-color:#3f3f46; } .ds-input:focus{ border-color:#f4f4f5; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,212,216,.4); } }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting container with a hairline border and soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#f4f4f5; border:1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius:16px; padding:20px; box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.10); display:grid; gap:20px; } .ds-card-title { font:600 24px 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; color:#18181b; } .ds-card-body { font:400 14px 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; color:#52525b; } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ .ds-card{ background:#09090b; border-color:#18181b; } .ds-card-title{ color:#f4f4f5; } .ds-card-body{ color:#a1a1aa; } }

components.name: Dialog Panel
components.description: Focused panel above a translucent overlay; one primary action.
components.html:
Delete template?

This cannot be undone.
components.css: .ds-overlay { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:50; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:20px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.9); } .ds-dialog { width:100%; max-width:448px; background:#fff; border-radius:16px; padding:20px; box-shadow:0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.25); display:grid; gap:12px; } .ds-dialog-title { font:600 18px 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; color:#18181b; } .ds-dialog-body { font:400 14px/1.5 'General Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; color:#52525b; } .ds-dialog-actions { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px; margin-top:8px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ .ds-overlay{ background:rgba(0,0,0,.9); } .ds-dialog{ background:#09090b; } .ds-dialog-title{ color:#f4f4f5; } .ds-dialog-body{ color:#a1a1aa; } }

components.name: Amber Icon Badge
components.description: The only accent surface: a circular amber-tinted icon holder.
components.css: .ds-icon-badge { width:48px; height:48px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(202,138,4,.2); color:#ca8a04; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }

components.name: Skeleton Loader
components.description: Loading placeholder; pulse only, no shimmer gradient.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { background:#e4e4e7; border-radius:8px; height:56px; animation:ds-pulse 2s infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity:.5; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ .ds-skeleton{ background:#27272a; } }

narrative.overview: A quiet, warm-neutral workspace where the tools recede and the work stays legible. The dashboard is an Operate surface: scanability and predictable controls outrank expression. Nothing shouts. Density is moderate — tight clusters of related controls inside generous containers — and every state change is legible at a glance. The palette is a zinc ladder on warm paper, with a single amber accent reserved for icon badges and brand moments. Theme switching is an inversion, not a rebrand: light uses black controls on white, dark uses white controls on near-black. Hue never changes with the theme; only value does.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white paper and deep warm ink as the outer frame, with zinc surfaces inside.
Inverting monochrome buttons; one amber accent, used sparingly.
One-pixel zinc borders plus soft shadows — depth is soft, never hard-offset.
Lucide icons at 13–20px, strokeWidth 2, usually inside a rounded-full tinted badge.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber appears in circular icon badges and brand marks only. It never becomes a button, a card fill, or a text color for body copy.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Light and dark swap value, never hue. A primary button is black on light and white on dark; adding blue or amber in dark mode is a violation.

rules.name: The Zinc Ladder Rule
rules.body: Every neutral — text, surface, border, placeholder — comes from one zinc step. Mixing slate, gray, or neutral families breaks the system.

rules.name: The Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and size step, never color intensity or letter-spacing below -0.02em.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Every input has a visible font-semibold capitalize label tied to its id.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows always have blur. Hard offset shadows are not part of this system.

rules.name: The Single Frame Rule
rules.body: One 1px border defines an edge; never stack multiple borders to fake depth.

dos: Do use FormButton, InputField, TextAreaField, SelectField and Layout for new UI rather than rebuilding their class strings.
Do pair every destructive action with a focused dialog that names the target and the consequence.
Do use aria-label on icon-only buttons and role=dialog / aria-modal on overlays.
Do keep amber inside circular badges; let black/white carry primary actions.
donts: Don't use window.confirm or window.alert — they break the workbench and cannot be styled or focused.
Don't introduce a second neutral family (slate, gray, neutral) alongside zinc.
Don't use hard-offset shadows or gradient text.
Don't put more than one primary button in a dialog.
Don't change hue between light and dark; swap value only.
